comments.text: Ngl, this is a pretty good script. For the inf stamina although, it's not infinite. You'll eventually run out of it, but what I recommend u to do is learn how to hook functions and metamethods. Trust me, once you learn those, you'll understand how to make the value of stamina the same. The god mode is pretty good, overall you have god mode over dozens of entities, except Lurker, Face, Tamara, etc. Fallen can't kill you with god mode, I had a crucifix in hand touched Fallen, he didn't get crucified, meaning I had god mode. The auto interact is kinda good, it still collects items that Greed modifies(which cannot happen, otherwise u get damaged). Ngl, I'm still looking for improvements in this script. I also made a script for this game using Linoria UI Library. The script I made also used a better ESP system. But I never ever knew how to obtain god mode, so I decided to make an auto hide feature. It also works if multiple entities are present, but doesnt make u hide against eye entities, etc. Ngl, I think this will turn out to be the #1 script for ENDLESS DOORS. Hope you learn hooking and improve your script! If you want to get the better ESP system, my dms are open. Just simply reply to this comment and I'll tell you my discord. Anyways, good luck learning hooking and improving ur script!
